name: DeepInfra
summary: DeepInfra is an inference cloud that serves open-weight and some proprietary models through an OpenAI-compatible API, billed per token, per image or per audio minute. It also rents dedicated GPUs for custom models by the minute and runs its own GPU data centers.
facts: Dedicated GPUs: H100 $2.90/h, B200 $4.89/h, billed per minute
Owns GPU infrastructure in eight US data centers plus Toronto
goodFor: Low per-token cost on open models
Cheap dedicated GPUs for custom models
watchOut: Not 100% compatible with every OpenAI parameter
No free tier; card or prepay required
